setting.name: reindex
setting.description: Reindex your library music collection in case you have recently added or removed music.

setting.name: resizeall
setting.explanation: Optimize Artwork will reduce the size of the artwork database when creating your music library. This will improve performance when using the BluOS Controller. However, it can take up to twice as long to create the music library.

setting.name: server
setting.explanation: Server Mode shares the music on a connected USB storage device across the network with other players.
